hero.title: BSKY-GP
hero.subtitle: Bluesky Grand Prix
hero.description: Compete with participants worldwide to grow your Bluesky followers as much as possible in 30 days!

register.title: Register
register.desc: Log in with your Bluesky account to register. Your follower count at registration becomes your baseline.
register.detail:
Simply log in with your Bluesky account to register.

Your follower count at registration is recorded as your 'baseline' — the starting point for your 30-day challenge.

You can re-enter anytime after your 30 days are up.

race.title: 30-Day Race
race.desc: Daily follower snapshots are recorded for 30 days from registration. Compete on maximum gain.
race.detail:
From registration, your follower count is automatically snapshotted every day for 30 days.

Competition is based on maximum gain — the participant who grows followers the most ranks highest.

Gains are tallied across three periods: daily, weekly, and monthly.

classSystem.title: Class System
classSystem.desc: Assigned to classes by baseline follower count (Rookie to Star). Compete within your class and overall.
classSystem.detail:
Your class is automatically set by your follower count at registration:

・Rookie (0–99)
・Rising (100–499)
・Challenger (500–999)
・Established (1,000–4,999)
・Influencer (5,000–9,999)
・Star (10,000+)

You compete in your class ranking and in the overall ranking across all classes.

periods.title: Daily · Weekly · Monthly
periods.desc: Gains aggregated over 3 periods. Each has its own independent ranking to evaluate your growth from multiple angles.
periods.detail:
Follower gains are aggregated over three periods:

・Daily: gain in the last 24 hours
・Weekly: gain in the last 7 days
・Monthly: total gain over the full 30-day challenge

Each has its own independent ranking, so you can shine with short bursts or steady long-term growth.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.dataUse: Data collected is used solely for ranking display and graph generation purposes.
privacy.section1Body: BSKY-GP collects the following information via Bluesky (AT Protocol) OAuth at registration:
privacy.section3Body: We do not sell or share your data with third parties. Handle, display name, avatar, and follower growth are publicly displayed within the service for ranking purposes.
privacy.section4Body: You can delete your account data anytime from My Page. After deletion, all entries, snapshots, and OAuth sessions linked to your DID are immediately removed.
privacy.section5Body: Cookies are used for session management and language preference. No third-party tracking cookies are used.
privacy.section6Body: For privacy-related questions, please contact the developer on Bluesky.
